plan.title: Vendors see best price in price-based auction

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for configuring auction strategy.
Create a live price-based auction, the subject of the test.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items.
Add the product needed for bidding.
Invite two vendors so the auction has competing bids and a current best price.
Publish the auction so vendors can bid.
Confirm the auction reached a real published project page.
Verify the first vendor bid was accepted.
Verify the second vendor bid was accepted.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the live auction's pricing view as the vendor.
Assert the vendor screen exposes the Best Price indicator.
Assert the vendor screen shows the current best bid value established by the lower bid.
